data.title: Search is lexical BM25 over the projection, not vectors and not the raw journal
data.why: Three choices in one. Lexical because an embedding model is 200 MB and seconds of cold start against a 200 ms budget and a promise to work offline, and because on a vocabulary of ULID, KAD-N, I7 and FlowEvent - tokens no model was trained on - exact matching is the stronger method, not the weaker one; the published evidence on small jargon-heavy corpora agrees. Over the projection because labels exist only after folding (I7), because the projection is what is true now so a superseded decision cannot answer as though it were current, and because it is the same source every other command reads, so search cannot disagree with task show. No persisted index because at 829 units a query costs 25 ms, which is less than deciding whether a cache went stale. Measured end to end: 152 ms against 141 ms for prime on the same run.
data.rejected: Embeddings, in the core: off by two orders of magnitude on both install size and cold start, and it would break the offline promise the moment the model had to be fetched.; Indexing the raw event files: no labels, no current state, and a second read path that would drift from the one every other command uses.; A persisted index keyed by the snapshot fingerprint: a second cache with its own staleness, to save 25 ms.
